Game Overview

In Run Snowball Run, the core idea is straightforward: guide Snowball, the courageous white cat, as you navigate endless obstacles in a fast-paced, retro pixel art adventure. Dash, dodge, and outsmart flying foes across infinite levels while chasing high scores in this thrilling endless runner challenge.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Run Snowball Run is easy to pick up. Guide Snowball, the courageous white cat, as you navigate endless obstacles in a fast-paced, retro pixel art adventure. Dash, dodge, and outsmart flying foes across infinite levels while chasing high scores in this thrilling endless runner challenge.
